text:
Maya (Growth): heads-up: finalizing social rollout for the 'Operationalizing Inference' webinar. goal: NA morning + APAC evening coverage. need copy + assets by EOD so we can stagger posts. @Diego @Samira can you own? :calendar:
Diego (Content): got it. i'll produce 2 headline options + 2 short thread replies for engagement. prefer concise stat-led copy.
Samira (Creative): i'll make a static hero + 4s GIF for X and a 3-slide carousel for LinkedIn. uploading to the Launch folder now: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/op-inf-assets :arrow_up:
Jordan (PMM): quick POI for messaging: highlight predictable latency and a small customer anecdote about dropping inference cost 40%. i'll drop a 1-pager in confluence later.
Riley (SDR): SDR routing: i'll own live replies. plan: tag leads with webinar=op-inf and source=x or li. webhooks set to https://hooks.redwood.ai/sdr. escalation: >5 replies from same org -> AE queue.
Maya (Growth): reply templates please — we want 3 starter replies: thanks+reg CTA, short stat hook+reg, offer to demo/book. Diego can you draft?
Diego (Content): draft replies: "Thanks! Save your spot -> https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=op-inf"; "Quick stat: 40% lower infra cost in prod — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"; "Want a walkthrough? DM us or book: https://redwood.ai/demo". will make X-length variants.
Samira (Creative): uploaded: hero_v2.jpg, hero_loop_4s.mp4, li_carousel_1.png, li_carousel_2.png, alt text included. preview: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/op-inf-preview
Maya (Growth): cadence proposal: X (staggered) 07:30 PT, 10:30 ET, 18:30 SGT; LinkedIn publish 10:30 PT with carousel. test A/B headline on first X post.
Diego (Content): headline A: "Operationalizing Inference: predictable latency, lower cost"; headline B: "Ship LLM features with production-grade inference". i'll run 50/50 with tag ab_headline=opinf and track CTR -> reg. primary will be A unless metrics disagree.
Riley (SDR): routing doc added to confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sales/op-inf-routing. webhook verified against #sdr-live.
SchedulerBot: posts scheduled: X 1738044000 / 1738054800 / 1738096200; LinkedIn 1738051200. preview: https://app.redwood.ai/scheduler/1738007330
Maya (Growth): action list: Diego (copy variants by 2pm PT), Samira (final assets by 12pm PT), Riley (webhook/routing verified EOD), Jordan (bench bullets EOD). review at 3pm sync. :thumbsup:
Diego (Content): will drop final copy in this thread for quick QA before publish.
Maya (Growth): thanks team — keep replies short so SDR handoff is clean. ping me if blocked. :sparkles:
